purpose: Survey archives broadly, persist only records that are informatively connected to the current web, and prevent generic archive/collection membership from masquerading as a substantive relationship.

failure_that_motivated_v2_1.diagnosis: Generic collection tags such as NARA/UAP contributed enough relationship score to pull many records whose only substantive commonality was collection membership.

confound_controls.tag_weighting: Corpus IDF without a +1 baseline; a tag present in every record has zero information.
confound_controls.informative_tag_gate: Shared tags contribute only in proportion to both weighted Jaccard overlap and absolute shared information.
confound_controls.graph_clique_control: Low-IDF collection tags may remain provenance context nodes but do not generate document-document SHARED_ENTITY cliques.

storage.large_binary_policy: pointer/hash only unless explicitly bounded and justified
